trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(td:Document), (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(pd:Document), (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(od:Document), (c:City)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(cd:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t), (o)-[:Owns]->(t), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c) WHERE CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) <= 2005 OR p.position = 'Backcourt' OR CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 41 RETURN t.team_name AS col1, SUM(DISTINCT CAST(c.area AS DOUBLE) * 0.09290304) AS col2
